title: What do classmates believe?
hook: Two stated cases: explore a perceived norm held against contrary information.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a perceived norm held against contrary information affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Estimate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a perceived norm held against contrary information in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
